title: 邦加深水油田
summary: 邦加是奈及利亞深水油氣開發案例；課程以既有浮式處理中心的延伸使用分析容量和檢驗證據。本課依序分析延伸服務的分離負荷、新增來油與緩衝、長期服役接口、海上修復等待、循環歷史與延續使用，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Bonga is a Nigerian deepwater development; this case analyses capacity and inspection evidence for continued use of a floating hub. The course analyses separation duty during extended service, additional feed and buffering, long-service interfaces, offshore repair waiting, cycle history and continued use, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Separation duty during extended service" is correct?
options: 停留時間是有效液體容積除以流率；容積不能直接使用設備外形體積，因為氣相空間、內件與不可用區域會縮小液體庫存。
停留時間足夠長就保證所有乳化油水完全分離。
儲槽總容量就是隨時可用的產品庫存。
optionsEn: Residence time is effective liquid inventory divided by flow.
A long residence time guarantees complete separation of every emulsion.
Nominal tank capacity equals immediately usable product inventory.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Separation duty during extended service” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Bonga deepwater field”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 本案例的分析界面是「延伸服務的分離負荷」。邦加是奈及利亞深水油氣開發案例；課程以既有浮式處理中心的延伸使用分析容量和檢驗證據。在「邦加深水油田」的教學模型中，先把這個界面和相鄰設備分開，再使用下列方法。停留時間是有效液體容積除以流率；容積不能直接使用設備外形體積，因為氣相空間、內件與不可用區域會縮小液體庫存。停留時間只是一項篩選指標，粒徑、乳化、密度差與流場短路仍會控制真正分離效果。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case interface is “Separation duty during extended service”. Bonga is a Nigerian deepwater development; this case analyses capacity and inspection evidence for continued use of a floating hub. In the teaching model for Bonga deepwater field, separate this interface from adjacent equipment before applying the following method. Residence time is effective liquid inventory divided by flow. The outer vessel volume is inappropriate because gas space, internals and inactive regions reduce usable inventory. Residence time is only a screening metric; droplet size, emulsions, density contrast and hydraulic short-circuiting still govern real separation performance. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 延伸服務的分離負荷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Separation duty during extended service: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「延伸服務的分離負荷」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Separation duty during extended service” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t = V/Q；代入 V = 49.5 m³、Q = 300 m³/h，得 9.90 min（「延伸服務的分離負荷」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Q 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: t = V/Q; with V = 49.5 m³, Q = 300 m³/h the result is 9.90 min (simplified exercise for Separation duty during extended service; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Q by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Q 增加 10% 時，結果變為 9.00 min（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Q by 10% changes the result to 9.00 min (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 9.90 min（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Q 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 9.90 min (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Q with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 延伸服務的分離負荷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Separation duty during extended service: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「延伸服務的分離負荷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Separation duty during extended service” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「延伸服務的分離負荷」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。用教學槽的有效容積與出入口流率計算平均停留時間，再比較示蹤曲線的前緣與平均值，判斷是否出現旁通與死區。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Separation duty during extended service”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Calculate mean residence time from effective inventory and inlet/outlet flow, then compare tracer-curve arrival and mean time to identify bypassing and inactive regions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成果檔以 025-01 標記，圖表須寫明「邦加深水油田：教學假設」。提交容積定義、流率基準及示蹤曲線解釋，將分離效率與停留時間分成兩個驗收量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 025-01 and mark charts “Bonga deepwater field: teaching assumptions”. Document the inventory definition, flow basis and tracer interpretation, treating separation efficiency and residence time as separate acceptance quantities.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「延伸服務的分離負荷」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Separation duty during extended service” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 延伸服務的分離負荷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Separation duty during extended service: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「延伸服務的分離負荷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Separation duty during extended service” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 「延伸服務的分離負荷」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。液位看似正常但入口擾動可能使細液滴穿越；如果把總罐容當成有效液容，停留時間會被高估並掩蓋短路流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「邦加深水油田」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: An error at “Separation duty during extended service” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first.
